unit: WF4 Build Integrity Halt Notice distinct-action count
description: The owner-facing heading and the audit row must use the guard's DISTINCT ambiguous-action count (integrity_conflict_count), not the raw conflict-record count (integrity_conflict_record_count / integrity_detail.length), so the notice agrees with the guard's reason string instead of re-introducing the double count.
why_it_exists: harness/FINDINGS.md section 1, open half (closed 2026-08-28, D-COUNT-01). The Integrity Guard fix publishes integrity_conflict_count (distinct ambiguous action_ids) and integrity_conflict_record_count (raw conflict entries), but Build Integrity Halt Notice still echoed integrity_detail.length into the heading ('Conflicting records (12):') and into halt_conflict_count, so the owner and the Events audit row saw 12 where the guard said 6 ambiguous actions. This scenario feeds a guard-style halt item carrying 3 distinct ids reported as 5 records and pins the notice to 3, with the raw 5 carried separately as halt_conflict_record_count.

items.integrity_reason: More than one Action row could be selected for matter MAT-20260101-002. I will not choose between them, and I will not draft, approve, write state or send until a human decides which row is the action. 3 ambiguous action(s) found, reported as 5 conflict record(s).

assertions: halt_conflict_count is 3, the guard's DISTINCT ambiguous-action count, not 5, the raw record count
halt_conflict_record_count carries the raw 5 so the Events audit row loses no information
the owner-facing heading reads 'Conflicting records (3):' and therefore agrees with the guard reason ('3 ambiguous action(s) found, reported as 5 conflict record(s).')
halt_code and halt_stage classify the item as a pre-draft Integrity Guard halt
the passthrough fields survive onto the notice item
